own_solution.law: Tsiolkovsky rocket equation, dv = u ln(m0/mf) (momentum conservation with no external force)
assumptions: constant exhaust speed relative to rocket
carried mass = body+engine+fuel (+ anything bolted to it)

notes: Base: 3 km/s * ln(3200/800) = 3 ln 4 = 4.1589 km/s. With 190 kg payload on the rocket: 3 ln(3390/990) = 3 * 1.23088 = 3.6926 km/s. Burn rate (27 kg/s) only sets burn time (~88.9 s) and cancels from the final speed (C). Payload on the tug or on a previous flight only has no path to this rocket's mass (D). T357D and T23F7 state no number ('small payload'), unlike the 190 kg variants; if they are intended as minimal-pair variants of the 190 kg sentences this would be a rendering mismatch, to check in pass 2.
